description: This U.S. Geological Survey data release combines Table 1, production of mineral commodities, from all published 2019 international country chapters of the Minerals Yearbook volume III Area Reports into one machine-readable table. The ScienceBase page says each chapter's Table 1 reports country-level mineral commodity production over five years, 2015 to 2019, and that no content of the original tables was changed, only reformatted. It was published on 21 August 2025 by the National Minerals Information Center as one CSV of about 3.3 MB with XML metadata, downloadable and free under CC0 1.0, with global coverage by country. Caveats: it covers only the 2019 chapters, footnoted estimates and revisions in the original tables need care, and commodity naming follows each chapter, so harmonisation is needed before comparison. For simulation it gives production by commodity and country for building mineral supply networks, weighting producing countries in supply disruption scenarios and checking trade-based material flow models. Related catalogue records include the BGS World Mineral Statistics, the USGS world minerals outlook to 2029 and the EV battery cathode material flows.
